blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for condos and townhomes in Heritage Mountain. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Heritage Mountain, Port Moody: 4 condos and townhomes listed at the end of October 2026 and 1 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 25% on only 4 listed, too few to read as a market type. By listings that is number 5 of 11 Port Moody communities for condos and townhomes.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Port Moody total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Listings of condos and townhomes in Heritage Mountain fell from 9 in June to 4 in October (−55.6%), and 7 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 2.4% of Port Moody’s 168 condos and townhomes listed.

blocks.text: Heritage Mountain Condos and Townhomes: streets and boundaries

items.t: The townhouse shelf on this, the western, side is Noons Creek Drive, Ravine Drive and Panorama Drive: Heritage Terrace at 795 Noons Creek Drive and Viewpoint at 181 Ravine Drive are the named complexes on those streets.
Heritage Mountain Community Centre at 200 Panorama Place is the civic anchor inside the attached-housing streets, beside Aspenwood Elementary at 2001 Panorama Drive.

blocks.text: Heritage Mountain Condos and Townhomes: the housing stock

items.t: Attached homes here are strata townhouses, plus a small number of apartment units: the Official Community Plan describes this grouping as detached homes and townhouses with a small number of apartments, and no apartment tower stands on the Heritage Mountain streets.
Eastern-side complexes at 2200 Panorama Drive, 15 Forest Park Way and 55 Hawthorn Drive belong to Heritage Woods, the eastern half of this grouping, and are not counted again here.

blocks.text: Heritage Mountain Condos and Townhomes: rules that affect buyers

items.t: A registered building scheme on title in this grouping takes precedence over small-scale multi-unit entitlements, and the City states it cannot process an application the scheme blocks — read title, not just zoning, on any townhouse lot assembly idea.

blocks.text: Heritage Mountain Condos and Townhomes: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Heritage Mountain Community Centre at 200 Panorama Place sits inside the townhouse streets themselves, not down the hill — the one civic facility in this grouping at walking scale.

Dogs may be off leash only on Bert Flinn Park's wide gravel trail from Heritage Mountain Boulevard and David Avenue, plus the morning mini-loop pilot — relevant to every ground-floor townhouse backing onto that forest.
Port Moody was declared a Bear Smart Community in 2024, and waste enclosures beside sensitive areas must be bear-resistant — a practical strata bylaw and garbage-room point in this forested grouping.

blocks.text: Heritage Mountain Condos and Townhomes: getting around

items.t: Route 184, Moody Centre Station / Noons Creek, serves the townhouse streets via Falcon Drive, Noons Creek Drive and Panorama Drive to Lansdowne Drive.
Route 183, Moody Centre Station / Coquitlam Central Station, runs via Heritage Mountain Boulevard and David Avenue and stops at Inlet Centre Station on Ioco Road.
Route 182, Belcarra / Moody Centre Station, serves the eastern Panorama and Forest Park Way side via David Avenue and Heritage Mountain Boulevard.

blocks.text: Heritage Mountain Condos and Townhomes: risks and due diligence

items.t: Check the Form B Information Certificate for approved special levies still payable, the contingency reserve fund balance and insurance summary before removing subjects on any unit here.
Check forest-interface wildfire position under the City Community Wildfire Protection Plan for complexes backing onto Bert Flinn Park forest.

blocks.text: Heritage Mountain home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

11 townhomes sold in Heritage Mountain with a median price of $1,320,000 (the middle half sold between $1,217,500 and $1,344,500), taking a median of 13 days to sell at 98.2% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $541 per square foot, a median year built of 1991 and a median strata fee of $581 a month.

A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Heritage Mountain?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 4 condos and townhomes listed in Heritage Mountain. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Heritage Mountain a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In October 2026, condos and townhomes in Heritage Mountain had a sales ratio of 25% on only 4 listed, too few to read as a market type. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Heritage Mountain from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 7 condos and townhomes sold in Heritage Mountain over those 5 months, out of 174 in all of Port Moody.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.

faq.q: Which elementary school is beside the Panorama Drive townhouses?
faq.a: Aspenwood Elementary at 2001 Panorama Drive stands on the same street shelf as the Panorama Drive and Panorama Place complexes. School District No. 43 assigns by home address and the Aspenwood, Heritage Mountain and Mountain Meadows catchments meet in this grouping, so confirm the complex's exact address in the School Locator.

faq.q: Is there a SkyTrain station for these townhouses?
faq.a: No station is in Heritage Mountain. Routes 183 and 184 connect the Noons Creek Drive, Panorama Drive and David Avenue stops to Inlet Centre Station and Moody Centre Station on the Millennium Line, so a strata buyer here still plans on a bus leg or a drive to the station.

faq.q: Can I rent out a Heritage Mountain townhouse long-term?
faq.a: Still read the complex's own bylaws and the Rental Disclosure Statement attached to the Form B, because pet, parking and move rules in those documents still bind the unit.

faq.q: What did townhomes in Heritage Mountain sell for?
faq.a: 11 townhomes sold in Heritage Mountain between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,320,000.

faq.q: How long do townhomes take to sell in Heritage Mountain?
faq.a: The median was 13 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 98.2% of the last list price (0% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
